editorial: Today's agenda is based on new search techniques that increase reasoning capacity in large language models and the rapid expansion of open source model architectures. In particular, 30 billion parameter level models such as Qwen and Muse continue to push the boundaries in terms of hardware efficiency and coding capabilities.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: Diagram-design developed for Claude Code offers 29 different editorial diagram types prepared directly in HTML and SVG format without using complex software. This tool makes it easy to create non-standard graphics in technical documentation with its simple design that reduces visual clutter.

items.title: cactus-compute/needle
items.summary: Developed by Cactus Compute, Needle is a small 14-megabyte foundation model that can run on hardware-constrained systems such as smartphones and wearable devices. This project offers a lightweight alternative optimized for running AI capabilities on local devices (edge ​​computing).

items.title: megadose/holehe
items.summary: Holehe is a Python tool that queries whether an email address is used on platforms like Twitter or Instagram. It detects the existence of accounts associated with the relevant email using password reset functions.

items.title: macro-inc/macro
items.summary: Macro combines business tools such as email, chat, documents, task management and customer relationship management (CRM) into a single workspace. Thanks to shared artificial intelligence memory, it centralizes team collaboration by connecting the data on all these platforms.

items.title: smicallef/spiderfoot
items.summary: SpiderFoot is a Python tool that automates open source intelligence (OSINT) collection for threat intelligence and attack surface mapping processes. It automatically aggregates information about your digital assets by scanning data sources on the Internet.

items.title: citrolabs/ego-lite
items.summary: Ego-lite is a fast web browser designed for artificial intelligence agents to perform browser automation. It allows users to take action without requiring manual intervention by sharing their logged-in browser state with coding assistants such as Codex or Claude Code.

items.title: holaboss-ai/holaOS
items.summary: holaOS is an open source platform that allows users to manage AI agents such as Claude Code and Codex in a single workspace with the browser, files, and over a hundred integrations. Offering a shared memory structure, this tool allows you to use your own models or choose ready-made models.

items.title: github/spec-kit
items.summary: Developed by GitHub, Spec-kit is a Python toolkit that accelerates specification-driven development processes. It aims to increase code quality and development discipline by setting standards in software projects.

items.title: lightningpixel/modly
items.summary: Modly is a desktop application that generates three-dimensional models from images or text commands. It works without the need for cloud-based services by performing all operations on the local graphics processing unit (GPU).

items.title: infiniflow/ragflow
items.summary: RAGFlow is an open-source fetch-assisted generation (RAG) engine that creates an advanced context layer for large language models (LLM). The system combines RAG technology with agent capabilities to automate complex data processing processes.

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Code editing tool Cursor has published an official plugin specification so developers can create their own plugins. This standard makes it possible to extend the functionality of the software development environment with TypeScript-based plugins.

items.title: deepseek-ai/awesome-deepseek-agent
items.summary: shared on GitHub, awesome-deepseek-agent is a resource collection that lists artificial intelligence agents (AI agents) developed with DeepSeek models and tools in this field. It brings together projects and integrations that help developers build autonomous systems using the DeepSeek infrastructure.

items.title: semantica-agi/semantica
items.summary: Semantica offers a graph-native infrastructure that provides contextual data management and accountability in artificial intelligence systems. Developed with Python, this tool helps artificial intelligence models produce more reliable and traceable results by managing complex data relationships.

items.title: rustdesk/rustdesk
items.summary: Developed with Rust, RustDesk is an open source remote desktop application that you can host on your own server. Offering remote access and control, this software creates an alternative solution to paid services such as TeamViewer.

items.title: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
items.summary: OpenCut is a software project developed as an open source alternative to the video editing tool CapCut. This application, created with the TypeScript language, allows users to manage their video editing processes on their own local systems.

items.title: unslothai/unsloth
items.summary: Unsloth provides a native working and fine-tuning environment for large language models (LLM) and rendering models. This Python-based tool allows you to train popular artificial intelligence models faster and with lower memory usage.

items.title: ToolJet/ToolJet
items.summary: ToolJet is an open source application creation platform for developing in-house tools, dashboards and artificial intelligence agents. This JavaScript-based infrastructure enables businesses to digitize complex workflows by reducing the need to write code.

items.title: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
items.summary: GLM-5.3, published by Z.ai, is a new large language model that is used in software development processes and includes cyber security capabilities. The model is optimized for high performance on complex tasks such as coding and system analysis.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B, the large language model developed by Alibaba, offers high-performance inference with low precision (FP8) data format. The model aims to optimize the balance of efficiency and speed in complex tasks with its structure of 27 billion parameters.

items.title: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
items.summary: Users state that current versions of Claude 3 Opus, the large language model developed by Anthropic, perform lower than previous versions and make more errors in complex tasks. This brings into question the effects of changes in the model's response quality on the developer experience.

items.title: Firefox is now the last major browser that still supports uBlock Origin
items.summary: Google Chrome has completed its Manifest V3 migration, which restricts the operation of extensions such as content blocker uBlock Origin. Despite this technology change, Firefox is the only major browser that continues to support the popular ad blocker uBlock Origin.

items.title: Seven books I keep close because I love them
items.summary: Mark Dominus, known for his work on software development and linguistics, shares seven basic books that he constantly references in his personal library. The list focuses on works that shape the mindset of professionals in the software world with their technical depth and literary quality.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, Qwen2.5-27B is a multi-modal large language model that can process text and image data. The model stands out with its ability to generate text-based responses by analyzing complex visual content.

items.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
items.summary: Muse-Glimmer-30B, developed by Meta, is a multimodal language model (multimodal model) that can process both visual and text data. This model makes visual content easier to understand by analyzing complex images and generating text-based responses.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a comprehensive language model that focuses on text generation capabilities. Trained on large data sets, this model aims to deliver high performance in complex language processing tasks.

items.title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
items.summary: Unsloth has introduced an optimized version of the Qwen2.5-32B model (GGUF format) that reduces memory usage and increases training speed. This version enables large language models to run more efficiently, even on low-end systems.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3
items.summary: MiniMax-H3, developed by MiniMaxAI, is a generative AI model that creates video using visual and text inputs. It allows users to convert static content into moving images.

items.title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
items.summary: Maglev is a recurrent Transformer architecture that generalizes the sliding-window attention mechanism by using fixed-size memory. Thanks to its parallelizable structure during training, it processes long contexts efficiently by combining a prefiller and a decoder model with access to the full history.

items.title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
items.summary: Thought-level beam search is a method that focuses on the most efficient use of processing power in large reasoning models. This approach aims to optimize reasoning processes by directing hardware resources to the most promising solutions.

items.title: RibAssist 3D: Biplanar Rib-Fracture Detection, Addressing, and Selective 3D Localization from CT-Derived Projections
items.summary: RibAssist 3D is a diagnostic system developed to detect and position rib fractures in three dimensions (3D) on computed tomography (CT) images. It aims to determine fracture points with high accuracy by matching images taken from two different angles.

items.title: Context-Matched Distillation: Teacher Causality for Autoregressive Video Distillation
items.summary: Context-matched distillation is a method developed to provide low latency and precise online control in interactive video production. This technique trains autoregressive video models, aiming to ensure that the student models adapt to causal constraints based only on historical data.

items.title: From Inaudible Inputs to Model Failures: Low-Frequency Safety Risks in LALMs
items.summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can process low-frequency signals that humans cannot hear, affecting their output. Researchers reveal the vulnerability of models to these signals with the method called Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout, which they developed to test this vulnerability.

items.title: RISC-V: They Should Have Known Better
items.summary: The open source processor architecture RISC-V has been criticized for complexities on hardware design and instruction set architecture (ISA). Software developers argue that this architecture contains some design errors in scalability and security compared to existing standards.

items.title: ActivityPub Won by Being Boring
items.summary: Decentralized social networking protocol ActivityPub has gained wide acceptance thanks to its simple and sustainable structure that avoids complex features. This approach demonstrates the importance of simplicity in the long-term success of open standards that enable platforms to communicate with each other.

items.title: Curl Performance
items.summary: The data transfer tool curl performs optimizations on the HTTP/3 protocol and connection management processes to improve network performance. These improvements aim to provide more efficient data transfer by reducing latency in high-traffic systems.

Gaining speed by processing data at the point closest to the device itself, instead of remote servers at the center.
Management system that allows companies to track their interactions and historical information with their customers in one place.
A method of collecting and analyzing information from publicly available sources on the Internet.
All stored information of your internet browser, such as currently open tabs, cookies and the accounts you are logged into.
Autonomous artificial intelligence software that makes decisions on its own and uses tools to achieve certain goals.
The process of determining all technical requirements and rules in detail before starting to code the software.
Special processor used to process images on a computer and speed up heavy mathematical calculations such as artificial intelligence.
Artificial intelligence models trained with huge data that can understand human language and produce text.
A method that allows artificial intelligence to benefit from current and private documents in addition to its own knowledge when producing answers.
A set of technical rules that must be followed in order to make an external add-on to a software.
A special database structure that stores and processes data based on their relationships with each other.
The process of retraining a general-purpose trained artificial intelligence with a small data set to make it more expert on a specific subject.

Artificial intelligence models trained with huge data that can understand human language and produce text.
A data format that represents numbers in a smaller footprint to make AI calculations faster.
